description: This file contains the implementation of the ProductPriceService interface, providing methods to add descriptions, save or update, and delete ProductPrice entities within an e-commerce system. It interacts with a DAO layer and extends a generic service class for common operations.

classes.name: ProductPriceServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing product pricing related operations, including adding descriptions, saving/updating, and deleting price entities.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a ProductPrice object and updates it.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new ProductPrice or updates an existing one, including managing its descriptions.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a ProductPrice entity after fetching it by ID to handle detached instance issues.
